definitions.execution_target: Joint 0=NONE,1=LONG_ONLY,2=SHORT_ONLY,3=BOTH when both branches COMPLETE; success net > minimum_net_R*causal R; all other statuses unknown
definitions.label_runs: Observed equal labels sampled every30s; run measure=count*30s, not a continuously observed economic duration. Unknown/date/gap ends a run. Internal runs have known labels at both boundaries.
definitions.lags: Within the same day and exact timestamp lag; endpoints must both have mature labels and admitted causal features. No circular shift, cross-day pairs, fitted model or predictive interpretation.
definitions.overshoot: Executed net minus nominal +G or -R, divided by causal R. Combines first threshold overshoot and close latency; it is not pure latency slippage because trigger price is not saved.
definitions.costs: C=(entry spread+roundtrip fee)/R is initial negative liquidation mark. Relative liquidation quote must improve by G/R+C to take; adverse allowance is stop_multiple-C. Quote-side move, not an assumption of constant spread midpoint dynamics.
definitions.feature_missing: Per-feature and family fractions use source-admitted roots; missing source origins reported separately, not filled or dropped silently.
definitions.execution_counts: Two independent alternative side trials per origin; these outcomes are not summable account equity.
definitions.risk: Frozen source R=max(2*(decision spread+.30),.10*decision BB1 half,.50); no thresholds tuned in this diagnostic.
definitions.sampling: Five previously inspected days; descriptive diagnostics, no inference of independent sample count or out-of-sample trading value.
